title: 第651章 神族覆灭第650章 准备关门打狗
slug: 师门不要我反手建个更强的
content_zh:
云星落缓步走出，双目微闭，指尖掐动繁复天机卦诀。
丝丝缕缕玄妙的天机气流萦绕在她周身，天地间隐晦的运势脉络被她层层推演。
众人全都安静下来，目光紧紧落在她的身上，满心忐忑。
片刻后，云星落睁开双眼，眸中精光一闪，眼底带着一丝了然与凝重。
“卦象大凶，但暗藏一线生机。”
她沉声开口，语气笃定，“我已经算出，前路大凶，巫族与雷族联手布下的绝杀埋伏，等着我们自投罗网。”
叶凌霜心头一紧：“果然，他们接连惨败，必然恼羞成怒，这次绝对会倾尽两族精锐，甚至举族出动，设下死局围杀我们！”
所有人都面露忌惮，前路凶险，堪称九死一生。
夜葬面色阴沉，正色道：“既然如此，那就先别去神族了，回宗门躲过一段时间再寻找时机出去。”
云星落淡淡一笑，摇摇头：“我们躲得过初一，躲不过十五。”
“巫族、雷族已然将我们视作必死之敌，今日我们躲了，他日他们依旧会四处追杀，永无止境。与其被动逃窜、处处受制，不如借此机会，一次性彻底解决所有隐患！”
众人闻言皆是一震，霍小棠疑惑道：“小师妹你是不是想到了破局之计？”
“当然。”
云星落抬手一挥，一张古朴浩瀚的玄黄界地图悬浮在众人眼前。
她指尖落在地图西南角的连绵山脉上，缓缓开口：“此地距离前方五百里，便是玄黄界的十万大山。”
“整个玄黄界所有古族，巫族、雷族、风族、岩族、灵族、神族等等，足足二十来个上古氏族，全部居住在这十万大山之中。”
众人纷纷凑近，凝神倾听。
“十万年前上古大战落幕之后，天地灵气异变，法则残缺，几乎所有古族的镇族之宝，都陆续陷入沉睡、渐渐失灵，无法再动用全部神威。”
“这些年来，各大古族穷尽无数办法修复唤醒，甚至暗中前往外界求助各方强者，最终全都无功而返。这是所有古族最大的心病，也是他们最大的执念！”
夜葬眸光骤然一亮，瞬间明白了云星落的意思：“我明白了，你的意思是，我们可以借助唤醒镇族之宝这件事，撬动所有古族的力量，破掉巫族与雷族的埋伏？”

“没错。”
云星落点头，嘴角勾起一抹浅笑，“巫族、雷族想借地利围杀我们，我们便借大势破局！”
“不过现在要做的事是我得先让这些古氏族相信我能激活他们的镇族之宝。”
说罢，她抬手凝诀，指尖灵光流转，快速炼制出十多数张影像符。
她将之前自己唤醒巫族、雷族镇族之宝的画面一一录入影像符中。
画面清晰无比，神威浩荡，真实可信。
做完这一切，她转头看向七玄，沉声吩咐：“七玄，你和青鹏以最快的速度前往十万大山，将这些影像符送往风族、岩族、灵族等所有古族才上。但，巫族和雷族除外。”
“你务必告知各族族长，我能帮他们彻底激活沉睡的镇族之宝，想要复苏族中至宝者，即刻前往神族地界汇合，我给只他们两天时间，过时不候！”
七玄扑棱着翅膀，眼神凌厉：“放心，事情交给七玄，一定能办妥。”
话音未落，他身形一动，和青鹏一起，撕裂空间，转瞬便消失在天际，向着十万大山的方向疾驰而去。
云星落收起手中地图，和三人一起，大张旗鼓前往神族。
content_en:
Yun Xingluo walked out slowly, eyes slightly closed, fingertips pinching the complicated Tianji hexagram formula.
Wisps of mysterious heavenly energy lingered around her, and the obscure fortunes between heaven and earth were deduced by her layer by layer.
Everyone fell silent, their eyes focused on her, filled with anxiety.
After a moment, Yun Xingluo opened his eyes, his eyes flashed with a hint of understanding and solemnity.
"The hexagram is very bad, but there is a glimmer of hope."
She spoke in a deep voice, with a firm tone, "I have calculated that there is a big danger ahead. The Wu Clan and the Thunder Clan have jointly set up a deadly ambush, waiting for us to fall into the trap."
Ye Lingshuang's heart tightened: "Sure enough, they have been defeated miserably one after another, so they will definitely become angry. This time they will definitely use all the elites of the two clans, and even the whole clan will be dispatched to set up a deadly trap to surround us!"
Everyone looked fearful, and the road ahead was dangerous and could be said to have a narrow escape.
Ye Zang looked gloomy and said sternly: "In that case, let's not go to the God Clan for now. Go back to the sect and hide for a while before looking for an opportunity to go out."
Yun Xingluo smiled faintly and shook his head: "We can escape the first grade of junior high school, but not the fifteenth grade."
"The Witch Clan and the Thunder Clan have already regarded us as mortal enemies. If we hide today, they will still hunt us everywhere in the future, and there will be no end. Instead of running away passively and being controlled everywhere, it is better to take this opportunity to completely eliminate all hidden dangers at once!"
Everyone was shocked when they heard this, and Huo Xiaotang asked doubtfully: "Junior sister, have you thought of a way to break the situation?"
"Of course."
Yun Xingluo raised his hand and waved, and a simple and vast map of the Xuanhuang Realm floated in front of everyone's eyes.
Her fingertips landed on the continuous mountains in the southwest corner of the map, and she slowly said: "This place is five hundred miles away from the front, and it is the Hundred Thousand Mountains of the Xuanhuang Realm."
"All the ancient clans in the entire Xuanhuang Realm, including the Wu Clan, Thunder Clan, Wind Clan, Rock Clan, Spirit Clan, God Clan, etc., there are more than twenty ancient clans, all living in this hundred thousand mountains."
Everyone came closer and listened attentively.
"After the end of the ancient war a hundred thousand years ago, the aura of heaven and earth changed, and the laws were incomplete. Almost all the ancient clan's treasures fell into slumber, gradually failed, and could no longer use their full divine power."
"Over the years, the major ancient tribes have tried countless ways to repair and awaken, and even secretly went to the outside world to ask for help from powerful people from all sides, but in the end they all returned without success. This is the biggest heart disease of all ancient tribes, and also their biggest obsession!"
Ye Zang's eyes suddenly lit up, and he instantly understood what Yun Xingluo meant: "I understand. What do you mean is that we can leverage the power of all the ancient clans to break the ambush of the Witch Clan and the Thunder Clan by awakening the clan's treasure?"
"That's right."
Yun Xingluo nodded, with a slight smile on his lips, "The Wu Clan and the Thunder Clan want to take advantage of the location to surround us, so we will take advantage of the general situation to break the situation!"
"But what I have to do now is to make these ancient clans believe that I can activate their clan-suppressing treasure."
After saying that, she raised her hand to condense the talisman, and with the light flowing from her fingertips, she quickly refined more than a dozen image talismans.
She recorded the previous scenes of her awakening the treasures of the Witch Clan and the Thunder Clan into the image talisman.
The picture is extremely clear, powerful, and authentic.
After doing all this, she turned to look at Qixuan and said in a deep voice: "Qixuan, you and Qingpeng go to Shiwanda Mountain as quickly as possible and send these image talismans to all the ancient clans such as the Wind Clan, Rock Clan, and Spirit Clan. Except for the Wu Clan and the Thunder Clan."
"You must tell the clan leaders of each clan that I can help them completely activate the sleeping treasure of the clan. Those who want to revive the clan's treasure should immediately go to the realm of the Gods to meet up. I will only give them two days, and we will not wait if they are late!"
Qi Xuan fluttered his wings and said with sharp eyes: "Don't worry, leave the matter to Qi Xuan and we will definitely get it done."
Before he finished speaking, he moved, and together with Qingpeng, he tore apart the space and disappeared into the sky in an instant, speeding towards the direction of Shiwan Mountain.
Yun Xingluo put away the map in his hand, and together with the three of them, made a big splashGo to the Gods.
